profile.headline: Software Engineer II | Python | JS | Java | C/C++ | Linux | Active Secret Clearance | L3Harris
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience developing reliable and scalable software systems in Linux environments. Currently working at L3Harris Technologies supporting mission-critical applications across the full software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, development, integration, testing, and deployment.
My technical background includes building backend services, APIs, and automation tools using Python, Java, C, and C++. I have experience working with distributed systems, integrating commercial off-the-shelf software solutions, and developing software that operates in secure and high-reliability environments.
I enjoy solving complex technical problems, improving system performance, and building maintainable software architectures that support long-term scalability and operational stability.
Technical areas I work in include:
• Python, Java, C, C++
• Linux (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu)
• API Development & System Integration
• Git, CI/CD, and DevOps workflows
• Docker and containerized environments
• Agile development and cross-functional engineering teams
Active Secret Clearance.
Always interested in connecting with other engineers and learning about new technologies, distributed systems, and large-scale software architectures.

Core Technologies: Python | Java | C++ | Linux | Docker | APIs | Git | CI/CD | PostgreSQL

For further information, please visit my website: https://ericww32.github.io/Willoughby_About/

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: After three years of collaborating with two exceptionally talented teams, I transitioned to a different team where I was responsible for maintaining software that had a history of ten years. My duties included conducting thorough testing, documenting the software’s functionality, and implementing software patches to address any identified issues. Later, I transitioned to a smaller team of three individuals, each with a primary objective: construct a PostgreSQL database, develop an API capable of processing requests and retrieving information from the database to render it on a web page frontend, and accomplish this endeavor within a budgetary constraint by utilizing repurposed components for the server.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Upon graduating from college and embarking on my career as a software engineer, I was filled with enthusiasm to begin my professional journey. Passionate about innovative technologies and committed to delivering exceptional results, I sought opportunities to collaborate with talented teams. During my initial two years, I worked with a remarkable team in Rochester, New York, who provided invaluable guidance and mentorship, shaping my professional development. Subsequently, I relocated to Melbourne, Florida, where I joined another team that entrusted me with greater responsibilities and introduced me to cutting-edge technologies.
